// Golden vectors for src/a2apb.tov. Each case is a realistic lf.a2a.v1 message as protojson input;
// the program parses it with protojson (a2a-go v2.5.0's a2apb/v1 types), then writes the bytes of
// proto.Marshal (deterministic) and the canonical protojson output (keys sorted, numbers as written
// by protojson). Run: go run . > tests/fixtures/a2apb_golden.json
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	_ "github.com/a2aproject/a2a-go/v2/a2apb/v1"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/encoding/protojson"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/reflect/protoreflect"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/reflect/protoregistry"
	_ "google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/emptypb"
	_ "google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/structpb"
	_ "google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/timestamppb"
)

type testCase struct {
	name    string
	message string // a name in lf.a2a.v1, or a full name of a well-known type
	input   string // protojson input
}

type golden struct {
	Name    string `json:"name"`
	Message string `json:"message"`
	Hex     string `json:"hex"`
	JSON    string `json:"json"`
}

const a2a = "lf.a2a.v1."

func newMessage(name string) (proto.Message, error) {
	full := name
	if len(name) < 7 || name[:7] != "google." {
		full = a2a + name
	}
	mt, err := protoregistry.GlobalTypes.FindMessageByName(protoreflect.FullName(full))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return mt.New().Interface(), nil
}

func main() {
	var out []golden
	for _, c := range cases {
		m, err := newMessage(c.message)
		if err != nil {
			fail(c.name, err)
		}
		if err := protojson.Unmarshal([]byte(c.input), m); err != nil {
			fail(c.name, err)
		}
		raw, err := proto.MarshalOptions{Deterministic: true}.Marshal(m)
		if err != nil {
			fail(c.name, err)
		}
		js, err := protojson.Marshal(m)
		if err != nil {
			fail(c.name, err)
		}
		canon, err := canonical(js)
		if err != nil {
			fail(c.name, err)
		}
		out = append(out, golden{Name: c.name, Message: c.message, Hex: hex.EncodeToString(raw), JSON: canon})
	}
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	enc := json.NewEncoder(&buf)
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	if err := enc.Encode(out); err != nil {
		fail("encode", err)
	}
	os.Stdout.Write(buf.Bytes())
}

// The JSON text with keys sorted and numbers as written, on one line.
func canonical(js []byte) (string, error) {
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(js))
	dec.UseNumber()
	var v any
	if err := dec.Decode(&v); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	b, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return string(b), nil
}

func fail(name string, err error) {
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s: %v\n", name, err)
	os.Exit(1)
}
